At the start of the battle round, you must pledge a number to Slaanesh, declaring how many enemy units you intend to destroy this round. At the end of the battle round, if the number of enemy units destroyed is equal to or greater than your pledge, you gain Pact points equal to the pledged number. If not, you lose 1D3 Pact points. Multiple Pact points can be spend at the same time and powers can be used multiple times per battle round. Remaining Pact points are carried over each battle round.
